calib_line: calibration: rich; validation Brier 0.1238 (n=125); test Brier 0.0617 vs base rate 0.0754 (n=179); features: log TVL, age years, change 7d, log TVL x age, cat:Liquid Staking, cat:Dexs, cat:Lending, cat:Bridge, cat:RWA, cat:Onchain Capital Allocator, cat:other (reference)
method: walk-forward: oldest 70% of tokenised peers by listed_at train, newest 30% test, ratio = median predicted / median realised mcap; leave-one-out: medians and growth/age coefficients refit without each peer, same ratio over all peers; brier (brier_model, brier_base): leave-one-out stratified odds vs tokenised label over every non-CEX protocol, base = leave-one-out global rate; brier_*_test: three candidates (base rate; plain logistic on log TVL, age years, 7d change; rich logistic adding log TVL x age and top-six category indicators, all standardised) trained on oldest 70% of the pool by listed_at; the winner is chosen on a validation slice (newest 30% of that training block) and its test Brier on the newest 30% is reported against the train base rate; row odds use the support-pooled stratified rate (>= 8 tokenised peers, finest -> category -> global); the logistic candidates are calibration checks only
